# Invalid data that yanglint rejects (scripts/yanglint-oracle.sh records it) and
# @node-net/yang must reject too, with the issue code and path given (test/oracle.test.ts).
# Modules: ietf-interfaces ietf-ip iana-if-type. One case per line:
#   input-file  issue-code  issue-path
# yanglint -t get parses without validating, so it accepts duplicate.xml: it
# finds duplicate leaves only when validating a whole datastore.
prefix-length.xml               invalid-value    /ietf-interfaces:interfaces/interface[name='eth0']/ietf-ip:ipv4/address[ip='192.0.2.1']/prefix-length
ip-pattern.xml                  invalid-value    /ietf-interfaces:interfaces/interface[name='eth0']/ietf-ip:ipv4/address/ip
namespace.xml                   wrong-namespace  /ietf-interfaces:interfaces/interface[name='eth0']/ipv4
unknown.xml                     unknown-node     /ietf-interfaces:interfaces/interface[name='eth0']/unknown-leaf
boolean.xml                     invalid-value    /ietf-interfaces:interfaces/interface[name='eth0']/enabled
missing-key.xml                 missing-key      /ietf-interfaces:interfaces/interface[name='eth0']/ietf-ip:ipv4/address
identity.xml                    invalid-value    /ietf-interfaces:interfaces/interface[name='eth0']/type
duplicate.xml                   duplicate-node   /ietf-interfaces:interfaces/interface[name='eth0']/description
json-number-as-string.json      invalid-value    /ietf-interfaces:interfaces/interface[name='eth0']/ietf-ip:ipv4/mtu
json-int64-as-number.json       invalid-value    /ietf-interfaces:interfaces/interface[name='eth0']/speed
json-unqualified-top.json       unknown-node     /interfaces
json-unqualified-augment.json   wrong-namespace  /ietf-interfaces:interfaces/interface[name='eth0']/ipv4
json-empty-as-null.json         invalid-value    /ietf-interfaces:interfaces/interface[name='eth0']/enabled
json-identity-unqualified.json  invalid-value    /ietf-interfaces:interfaces/interface[name='eth0']/type
